welcome.title: Run. Loot. Level up.
welcome.body: Every kilometer earns XP and treasure. Team up with friends to take down bosses, but only while you're running.
welcome.betaNote: Private beta: you'll need an invite code from a friend.

signup.title: Create your adventurer
signup.emailHint: Only used to send you a sign-in link if you ever lose your passkey.
signup.inviteHint: Ask a friend in the beta for a code like ABCD-1234.
signup.bootstrapNote: You're the very first player, so your account becomes the admin.
signup.passkeyExplain: A passkey lets you sign in with Face ID, a fingerprint or your screen lock. There's no password to remember.
signup.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

login.title: Welcome back
login.emailTitle: Get a sign-in link by email
login.emailSent: If that email has an account, a sign-in link is on its way. It works for 15 minutes.
login.emailDisabled: Email sign-in isn't set up yet. Use your passkey.

emailLogin.title: Signing you in…
emailLogin.missing: This link is missing its token. Request a new one.
emailLogin.addPasskeyTitle: Add a passkey on this device?
emailLogin.addPasskeyBody: Next time you can sign in with Face ID or your fingerprint instead of waiting for an email.

home.comingSoon: Runs, XP and loot arrive in the next phases. For now, make sure your phone is ready for adventure:

profile.title: Profile
profile.addPasskey: Add a passkey on this device

invites.title: Invite friends
invites.body: Each code lets one friend join the beta.
invites.unlimited: As an admin you can create as many codes as you like.
invites.shareText: Join me on Runhach, a running RPG! Use invite code {{code}} at {{url}}

deviceCheck.title: Device check
deviceCheck.intro: Tests what this phone can do during runs. Keep this screen open and allow any permission prompts.

details.notInstalled: Not yet. Use your browser's Share or menu button, then “Add to Home Screen”.
details.gpsWeak: Weak signal: accuracy {{accuracy}} m. Try outdoors.
details.gpsDenied: Permission denied. Allow location for this site in your settings.
details.gpsTimeout: No GPS fix within 20 seconds. Try outdoors.
details.vibrationIos: Not supported (normal on iPhone; you'll get sounds instead)
details.wakeLockOk: Screen can stay on during runs
details.speechOk: You should have heard a voice
details.soundOk: You should have heard a beep
details.vibrationOk: You should have felt a buzz
details.passkeysNoPlatform: Supported, but no built-in fingerprint/face unlock found

gpsLab.title: GPS lab
gpsLab.intro: Developer tool: test tracking without going for a run.

feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.placeholder: What happened? What did you expect?
feedback.sent: Thanks! Your feedback reached the team.

pwa.iosInstall: To install: tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.passkeysUnsupported: This browser doesn't support passkeys. Use the email link instead.
